results.b_title: Exact and Heuristic Computation of the Scanwidth of Directed Acyclic Graphs
results.mediator: Tree decompositions / bounded-treewidth (and more generally graph-minor) structure as a common width parameter linking undirected sparse classes to DAG width measures.
results.rationale_excerpt: Both papers sit within the structural/parameterized graph-theory ecosystem and share the underlying language of tree-like decompositions and minor/width parameters: series-parallel = treewidth 2, and scanwidth is a tree-decomposition-flavored DAG parameter whose underlying (undirected) bound is governed by treewidth-like quantities.

results.a_title: On the Spectral Expansion of Monotone Subsets of the Hypercube
results.b_title: Turnstile Streaming Algorithms Might (Still) as Well Be Linear Sketches
results.mediator: Discrete Fourier / Walsh analysis on abelian groups, with monotone (FKG-correlated) sets as the structured-subset analogue of heavy-frequency lattices, mediated by hypercontractivity / Bonami-Beckner and Rudin-type inequalities.
results.rationale_excerpt: Both papers ultimately do harmonic analysis on a discrete abelian group -- Paper A on the Boolean cube {0,1}^n with Walsh-Fourier characters, Paper B on Z^n with additive-combinatorics tools. The shared mathematical core is 'spectral concentration on a discrete group restricted to a structured subset.'
results.novelty_note: Specific named mediator: FKG-monotone sets as structured-subset analogue of heavy-frequency lattices.

results.b_title: Rectangular Duals on the Cylinder and the Torus
results.mediator: Rigidity of graphs realized on flat surfaces (toroidal/cylindrical generic rigidity, à la Ross, Schulze, Whiteley)

results.a_title: On quantum functionals for higher-order tensors
results.b_title: Hierarchies of Minion Tests for PCSPs through Tensors
results.mediator: Asymptotic-spectrum duality applied to tensorised minion preorders (Strassen-style semiring duality as the common abstraction for monotone tensor invariants)
results.rationale_excerpt: Both papers turn questions about discrete combinatorial/algebraic objects into questions about Kronecker/tensor powers and monotone functionals over them: Strassen's asymptotic spectrum is a max-min duality between tensors and real-valued semiring homomorphisms, while minion+tensorisation hierarchies are a max-min duality between PCSP templates and convex relaxations indexed by tensor powers.
results.novelty_note: Genuinely interesting: applies Strassen asymptotic spectrum theory to PCSP minion hierarchies. Both authors would benefit from this observation.

results.a_title: Noise sensitivity and variance lower bound for minimal left-right crossing in FPP
results.b_title: Adversarially-Robust Inference on Trees via Belief Propagation
results.mediator: Noise stability and reconstruction thresholds on graphical models: specifically, the Mossel-O'Donnell-style correspondence between BKS noise sensitivity of monotone boolean functions and non-reconstruction (correlation decay) for broadcast processes -- both governed by L^2 contraction of influence/log-likelihood operators on the underlying graph.
results.novelty_note: Specific named bridge: Mossel-O'Donnell correspondence between BKS noise sensitivity and broadcast-tree reconstruction, transferred from boolean functions to FPP crossings.
